payload.title: Clustering
payload.description: This notebook applies clustering algorithms to oceanographic data to identify watermasses based on multiple traits. It uses Scikit Learn's clustering tools to analyze tracer data from the C-iTRACE dataset, focusing on both surface and sectional data. The notebook demonstrates the use of various clustering techniques, including Mean Shift and TSNE, to visualize and interpret the spatial distribution of watermasses.
